feeds.title: Forgiving Forward » Forgiveness
feeds.description: This category of the Forgiving Forward Blog focuses on Forgiveness and the challenges one must overcome to do so. Other categories are Reconciliation, Life, and Freedom moving forward. Forgiving Forward is a collection of forgiveness blogs, mission work updates, and life-giving videos and interviews that will inspire you to forgive and help others forgive.

feeds.title: The Forgiveness Project Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about forgiveness and our charity in our blog series featuring articles by our director, founder, and guest contributors. Founded in 2014, The Forgiveness Project collects and shares stories from both victims/survivors and perpetrators of crime and conflict who have rebuilt their lives following hurt and trauma. We provide resources and experiences to help people examine and overcome their own unresolved grievances.

feeds.title: Thriveworks » Forgiveness
feeds.description: This category of our blog teaches ways to learn, understand and practice the quality of forgiveness. We also talk about overcoming trauma, and guilt, and how to achieve and maintain a healthy mental state. Thriveworks is a counseling chain that offers a variety of mental health services, including depression therapy, marriage counseling, life coaching, and more.

feeds.title: I Am Second Blog » Anger Forgiveness
feeds.description: Read stories of real people that impact the way we think, live, and believe. Stories that showcase the human mind's capacity for healing and making positive change, converting its anger and trauma into positive energy. I Am Second is a collection of Videos, Stories, and other online content that show Trauma Survivors talking about their experiences and recovery journeys.

feeds.title: Forays In Forgiveness Blog
feeds.description: The Forays into Forgiveness blog teaches you to live a truly forgiving and forgiven life. I'm Susan Dugan, a writer, a closet poet, a student, a teacher, and a mother. I hope to strengthen my commitment to my path, and deepen my learning, by sharing my journey with you. In this blog, I write my experiences, thoughts, and conversations with people that I find interesting.

feeds.title: International Forgiveness Institute Blog
feeds.description: The IFI is an outgrowth of the social scientific research done at the University of Wisconsin-Madison since 1985 by Dr. Robert Enright and his colleagues. Our theory is that such anger reduction in students will help them improve their interpersonal relationships to the point that they can begin to see, as they mature into adults, the best paths toward justice. This blog and other sources of research provide help to those seeking or learning to forgive.

feeds.title: Sikh Forgiveness Blog
feeds.description: Sikh Forgiveness is a place for the community to voice their mental health journey, and share their experiences, opinions, and solutions surrounding mental health. Our members and contributors break down stigma barriers and speak with an open heart and open mind. We support by working with charities, building networks, and providing perspective to seek support for the community.
